# Kritova

> AI solutions company based in Troy, Michigan. Kritova builds AI-driven products for real businesses across automation, fitness, hospitality, and other industries — engineered by Kritovians, a volunteer community of students, professionals, interns, and job-seekers who apprentice on real client projects in small pods mentored by experienced engineers ("Masters").

## What this page offers

- Custom AI solutions for automation, fitness, hospitality, and new verticals
- Kritova AI: an assistant in active development, built on a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architecture — hybrid retrieval, reranking, and grounded generation
- The Kritovian community: evening/weekend apprenticeships where contributors ship real, deployed products
- A four-stage delivery pipeline: Discover, Build, Deploy, Iterate — every project must reach real users
